allow: PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='powershell.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'ActivateWatcher' } | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine | Format-List)

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='powershell.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'ActivateWatcher\\.ps1' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'triggerFlagPath' } | Select-Object ProcessId, CreationDate)
